method: Six fictional editorial angles,12exposures each,3per optionposition; one rawcount per choice,all highestties. No morality/personality/clinical norms.

prompt.en: Friends are making a small welcome kit for a new hobby member. Which part would you choose?
prompt.zh: 朋友为兴趣小组新成员准备一份小小欢迎包，你更想做哪部分？

label.en: Find out which first-session information would actually help.
label.zh: 查清第一次参加真正需要哪些信息。

label.en: Offer to accompany them through the first activity.
label.zh: 提出第一项活动陪对方一起参加。

label.en: Make sure the simple promised items are ready to use.
label.zh: 把答应准备的基础用品落实好。

label.en: Choose one detail that reflects something the newcomer likes.
label.zh: 挑一处符合新成员喜好的细节。

prompt.en: A friend wants company at an unfamiliar community event. What would you most like to offer?
prompt.zh: 朋友想找人陪着去陌生活动，你最愿意提供什么？

label.en: A clear promise that I will join them for the part we agreed.
label.zh: 明确答应在说好的那一段陪着。

label.en: A realistic account of when I can come and what I can carry.
label.zh: 实话说明能几点到、能带哪些东西。

label.en: A thoughtful little item that makes arriving feel special.
label.zh: 准备一件贴心小物，让到场更有仪式感。

label.en: A light shared game we can use to meet people.
label.zh: 想一个轻松小游戏，方便一起认识人。

prompt.en: Your group is preparing a homemade picnic. Which contribution appeals most?
prompt.zh: 大家准备一次自制野餐，你更喜欢哪种贡献？

label.en: Say which preparation I can reliably finish, then do it.
label.zh: 说清自己能完成哪项准备，然后落实。

label.en: Make an ordinary place setting feel personally welcoming.
label.zh: 让普通的餐位布置多一点专属心意。

label.en: Invent a small playful activity people can join or skip.
label.zh: 想一个可参加也可跳过的轻松玩法。

label.en: Check whether people would prefer a quieter spot.
label.zh: 问问大家是否更想坐在安静一点的位置。

prompt.en: You are sending a thank-you note after a shared project. Which approach would you choose?
prompt.zh: 共同项目结束后写感谢卡，你更倾向怎样写？

label.en: Include a small detail that shows I noticed the person’s contribution.
label.zh: 写一个细节，让对方知道自己的付出被看见了。

label.en: Add a friendly little joke that fits our shared experience.
label.zh: 加一个适合共同经历的小玩笑。

label.en: Use words that leave the recipient comfortable replying in their own time.
label.zh: 用不催回复的措辞，让对方按自己的节奏看。

label.en: Explain clearly what I learned from doing the project together.
label.zh: 说清一起做这件事让自己学到了什么。

prompt.en: A casual meet-up has a short gap before the main activity. What sounds most inviting?
prompt.zh: 聚会正式活动前空出一小段时间，你更想怎么过？

label.en: Start a low-pressure guessing game with whoever wants to play.
label.zh: 和愿意的人玩个没有压力的猜谜。

label.en: Offer a calm corner where talking is optional.
label.zh: 留一个可以聊天也可以不说话的安静角落。

label.en: Explore a question about the activity we are about to try.
label.zh: 一起弄明白一个关于待会活动的小问题。

label.en: Check in with the friend I promised to spend time with.
label.zh: 先陪一会儿自己约好要见的朋友。

prompt.en: Someone joins your craft table but seems unsure where to sit. What would you prefer to do?
prompt.zh: 有人来到手工桌边，不太确定坐哪里，你更愿意怎么做？

label.en: Offer a place without making them the centre of attention.
label.zh: 留个位置，不让对方一下成了全场焦点。

label.en: Explain briefly how the table is arranged and ask what they want to try.
label.zh: 简单说明材料怎样放，再问想试什么。

label.en: Invite them to work beside me for the first small step.
label.zh: 邀请对方先在自己旁边一起做第一步。

label.en: Tell them plainly which supplies are free to use.
label.zh: 直接说清哪些材料可以随手用。

prompt.en: You can improve one part of a recurring friends’ activity. What would you choose?
prompt.zh: 可以改进朋友固定活动的一处安排，你更想改哪里？

label.en: Gather one useful question from participants before changing the plan.
label.zh: 先收集一个参与者真正想解决的问题。

label.en: Create an easy way for people to ask for a companion.
label.zh: 让想找人一起参加的人更容易约到伴。

label.en: Make the practical responsibilities explicit and manageable.
label.zh: 把实际分工说清，安排在能承担的范围内。

label.en: Give each person a small personal touch in the shared materials.
label.zh: 在共用材料里给每个人留一处个性化细节。

prompt.en: A friend asks for help preparing their first small exhibition. Which role attracts you?
prompt.zh: 朋友第一次办小型展览请你帮忙，你更喜欢哪个角色？

label.en: Be there during the agreed setup period so they are not alone.
label.zh: 在约好的布展时段到场陪着做。

label.en: Carry out one practical job and be clear about its limits.
label.zh: 落实一项实际工作，也说明自己能做到哪里。

label.en: Help present the work in a way that suits the maker.
label.zh: 让展示方式更贴合作者的心意。

label.en: Suggest an optional playful way for visitors to interact.
label.zh: 给观众想一种自愿参与的小互动。

prompt.en: A shared shelf needs organising. Which approach would you most enjoy?
prompt.zh: 大家共用的架子需要整理，你更喜欢哪种做法？

label.en: Sort the useful items and say honestly what space is available.
label.zh: 把有用的物品归好，实话说明还有多少空间。

label.en: Make labels that are pleasant and meaningful to their users.
label.zh: 做一套让使用者看着舒服、也看得懂的标签。

label.en: Add a small rotating surprise people can contribute to.
label.zh: 留一小格轮换惊喜，大家可以自愿放东西。

label.en: Arrange it so someone can browse without being hurried.
label.zh: 让想慢慢看的人不必被催着走。

prompt.en: Friends are exchanging inexpensive handmade gifts. What matters most in your approach?
prompt.zh: 朋友交换便宜的手作礼物，你更在意哪一点？

label.en: A choice of material or detail that fits this particular person.
label.zh: 材料或细节确实适合收到礼物的这个人。

label.en: The little moment of shared amusement when it is opened.
label.zh: 拆开时能一起会心一笑。

label.en: Letting the person enjoy it without needing a public reaction.
label.zh: 对方可以安静喜欢，不必当众表现。

label.en: Finding out enough about their interests to make a sensible choice.
label.zh: 先了解一点兴趣，再做有根据的选择。

prompt.en: You have ten spare minutes with a friend between activities. What would you rather suggest?
prompt.zh: 和朋友在两项活动之间多出十分钟，你更想提议什么？

label.en: Make up a tiny story using three things nearby.
label.zh: 用身边三件东西随口编个小故事。

label.en: Find somewhere comfortable and let the conversation take its time.
label.zh: 找个舒服位置，聊天不赶进度。

label.en: Investigate something we both wondered about during the activity.
label.zh: 查一查刚才共同好奇的那个问题。

label.en: Spend the time together doing the small thing I had promised.
label.zh: 一起完成先前答应陪对方做的小事。

prompt.en: A member of your group asks for a gentler version of an activity. What would you prefer?
prompt.zh: 小组有人想把活动调得温和一点，你更愿意怎样回应？

label.en: Ask which part would feel more comfortable, without demanding a reason.
label.zh: 问怎样会舒服些，不要求对方解释原因。

label.en: Find out which parts are essential and which can be adjusted.
label.zh: 先弄清哪些环节必要、哪些可以改。

label.en: Offer to stay alongside them during the version they choose.
label.zh: 提出按对方选的版本一起参加。

label.en: State what adjustment I can practically help provide.
label.zh: 说清自己实际能帮着调整哪一项。

prompt.en: A shared outing could follow two unfamiliar routes. What would you contribute first?
prompt.zh: 一次出游有两条陌生路线，你首先想贡献什么？

label.en: Useful information about what each route involves.
label.zh: 查清两条路线分别要面对什么。

label.en: A commitment to help keep our chosen group together.
label.zh: 答应在选定路线中照应同行的人。

label.en: A plain estimate of the time and supplies I can manage.
label.zh: 直接估计自己能承担的时间和物资。

label.en: One detail that could make the chosen route feel memorable.
label.zh: 找一处能让这条路线留下回忆的细节。

prompt.en: Your friend is showing a new hobby to several beginners. What would you most enjoy doing?
prompt.zh: 朋友给几位新手介绍自己的爱好，你最想怎么参与？

label.en: Join the first attempt so the friend has someone taking part beside them.
label.zh: 第一轮一起试，让朋友身边有人参与。

label.en: Handle a straightforward support job we have agreed on.
label.zh: 接下一项说好的简单支持工作。

label.en: Prepare a display detail that expresses their enthusiasm.
label.zh: 准备一处能表现对方热爱的展示细节。

label.en: Find a playful question that lets everyone join in casually.
label.zh: 想一个好玩的提问，让大家轻松加入。

prompt.en: After a shared meal, which small contribution would you choose?
prompt.zh: 一起吃过饭后，你更愿意做哪件小事？

label.en: Take the practical cleanup task I said I would cover.
label.zh: 把自己说好负责的清理工作做完。

label.en: Package leftovers with a considerate touch for whoever wants them.
label.zh: 给想带走的人细心装好剩余食物。

label.en: Mark a funny moment from the meal with a little shared memento.
label.zh: 把席间好笑的瞬间留成一个共同小纪念。

label.en: Check quietly whether anyone needs more time before leaving.
label.zh: 轻声问问是否有人还需要坐一会儿。

prompt.en: You are helping make a shared photo album. Which part attracts you?
prompt.zh: 一起做共同相册时，你更喜欢哪部分？

label.en: Choose a presentation detail that suits the people in the photos.
label.zh: 按照片里的人选择合适的呈现细节。

label.en: Write a playful caption that everyone pictured is comfortable with.
label.zh: 写一句照片中每个人都觉得舒服的俏皮配文。

label.en: Make it easy for someone to leave out a photo without explaining.
label.zh: 让不想放某张照片的人不用解释也能撤下。

label.en: Work out a simple way to collect accurate dates and context.
label.zh: 找一个简单办法把日期和背景核对清楚。

prompt.en: Friends want to recognise a very small milestone. Which celebration appeals most?
prompt.zh: 朋友想庆祝一个很小的进展，你更喜欢怎样庆祝？

label.en: Invent a brief, silly ritual that people can opt into.
label.zh: 临时想个简短傻气、自由参加的小仪式。

label.en: Ask whether the person would rather enjoy it quietly.
label.zh: 问当事人是否更想安静地开心一下。

label.en: Learn what made the milestone meaningful before choosing a response.
label.zh: 先了解这点进展为什么对对方有意义。

label.en: Turn up for the modest celebration we agreed to share.
label.zh: 按约定参加这场小小的共同庆祝。

prompt.en: At the end of an optional group session, what would you most like to leave behind?
prompt.zh: 一次自愿参加的小组活动结束时，你最想留下些什么？

label.en: Room for people to leave at their own pace without being pressed.
label.zh: 让大家按自己的节奏离开，不必被催。

label.en: One useful thing we now understand better together.
label.zh: 一件大家共同弄明白了的有用小事。

label.en: The feeling that I stayed present for the part I promised.
label.zh: 自己在答应的那段时间里确实陪着参与。

label.en: A finished practical contribution with no exaggerated promises.
label.zh: 一项完成了的实际贡献，不夸大承诺。
